summaries.n-credits-for-holders: Coins that describe turning trading fees into AI model credits for holders. Orbio (orbio.so) says it sells LLM credits at a discount, that the discount comes from Orbio holders who offer unused credit, and that requests are relayed through its managed OpenRouter account; its coin ORBIO (pons, Robinhood Chain) says half of trading fees are converted into inference credits paid to holders. API (pump.fun) says fees are split by holdings and holders can claim SOL or 1.5x credits for GPT, Claude, Grok and Gemini through one OpenAI-compatible API; LLMPad (LLM, pump.fun) says it lets anyone launch model tokens or trading agents and generate LLM credits; bInference (BINF, Flap, BNB Chain) says an agent token's fees pay for the agent's AI and that credits bought with BNB are up to 8% cheaper with $BINF. Public posts from 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-10 compare BINF and API with ORBIO, and a rival project, DecentraMind, says ORBIO pioneered the model it builds on. The ORBIO and BINF pools date from 2026-09-20 and 2026-09-30; the API and LLM pools were created on 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-10. These are the projects' and traders' own claims: payouts, discounts and usage are not verified, no affiliation among the coins was checked, and one post says 11 bundles bought 62% of LLM's supply around its launch. Raeto (RAETO, pons on Robinhood Chain; pool created 2026-10-12) says "Your tokenized stocks pay for your AI inference" and "earn credits for 400+ models", and joined on 2026-10-15 after passing the $100K market cap bar. Measured: five coins across all their pools.
summaries.n-programmable-rules: Coins from launchpads whose tokens carry rules enforced on-chain. Hooked (HOOKED, on Meteora's dynamic bonding curve) says rules are built into the token with Token-2022 transfer hooks, and the @MeteoraEco account described it on 2026-10-04 as letting builders choose who can hold, how tokens trade and who gets rewarded. SPEC (spec.fun's own page: Solana programmable extension coins, 73 extensions) and HOOKI (@Hoookedpad's 2026-10-05 post: an AI agent that rewrites a token's rules on Hooked) are on Solana; pickhooks (hooks, on Flap) describes itself in its metadata as a launchpad on BNB Chain where coins carry rules, and its own account announced version 2 on 2026-10-04. IGNITION (pons, Robinhood Chain; pool created 2026-10-13) says its tokens can be renamed, re-tiered and have their hook logic rewritten after launch, and @HoodInsiderHB posted on 2026-10-14 that IGNITIONRH went live on Robinhood Chain mainnet as a launchpad with editable tokens. These are project descriptions; whether the rules work as described, and any affiliation among the five coins beyond the Hooked-HOOKI link, is not verified, and one public review notes hooks are not permanent by default. Measured: five coins across all their pools.
